name: NPM-Sync
description: Keeps several Nginx Proxy Manager instances in sync, like adguardhome-sync.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: npm-sync web page and API, published on host as 6720

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: MASTER_URL
variables.description: Required. The admin address of the Nginx Proxy Manager that is the source, like http://192.168.1.20:81 (replace CHANGEME-MASTER with its IP).

variables.name: MASTER_USERNAME
variables.description: Required. The email of an NPM user on the master, without two-factor sign-in. A user just for npm-sync is best.

variables.name: BACKUP1_URL
variables.description: Required. The admin address of the NPM that receives the copy, like http://192.168.1.30:81. Add BACKUP2_URL and so on for more.

variables.name: BACKUP1_USERNAME
variables.description: Required. The email of the npm-sync user on that NPM.

variables.name: WEB_USERNAME
variables.description: The user name for npm-sync's own web page.

variables.name: WEB_PASSWORD
variables.description: A password for npm-sync's web page. Set one: without it anyone on your network can start syncs there.
